Hi Elena,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. We're opening a vendor master for EverGrove so AP can route POs and invoices cleanly. To complete setup can you confirm the following and attach the supporting docs?

- Exact legal entity name to use for the vendor record (as it should appear on contract/W-9).
- EIN / Tax ID (format: XX-XXXXXXX).
- Registered address (street, city, state, postal).
- Remittance contact (name + email + phone) and preferred invoice file format (PDF, PDF with PO on first page, EDI).
- ACH bank details or a bank letter for ACH authorization (we can mask account numbers in the portal).
- Name/email of the authorized signer for vendor agreements.
- Any DBA or trading names we should record.

I'm attaching our vendor_onboarding_form_v3.pdf for your convenience — if you can fill/return that and the W-9/certificate of incorporation we'll push this through.

Notes on Redwood side: Karthik (AP) will provision a temporary vendor code for initial onboarding and Grace (Proc Ops) will confirm PO routing once docs are validated. Our default payment terms are Net30 unless otherwise negotiated; let us know if you require different terms.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can create the vendor record this week.

Thanks,

Elena — once you confirm the name I'll update the portal record and we can push the PO to your billing contact.
